# Erik Norris

Erik Norris is an engineer and the principal of Mechanistic, an independent engineering practice. He works on product architecture and systems integration, carrying decisions through design, testing and manufacturing. His practical engineering judgment draws on automotive repair, electronics and product development. His work includes food automation at Hyphen, home-cinema systems at Kaleidescape and professional audio at Digidesign, alongside current work on software tools for engineering.
